entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: There's something I'd like to ask you.

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: I see you're already getting on top of the[n]problem I'd mentioned this morning,[n]Ms. Kawakami! I appreciate the support.

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: Oh, you know this guy, Yoshizawa?

entries.speaker: Student Called Yoshizawa
entries.en: Yes, he lent me a helping hand earlier.

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: I recommend you steer clear of the likes[n]of him if you have any consideration for[n]your future.

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: Remember the discussion we just had?[n]There are a number of students in this[n]school you shouldn't get involved with...

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: This one's at the top of the list.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Sorry to interrupt, but I need to use[n]the guidance office.

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: We should be going too—don't want[n]to get in the way of guiding this[n]delinquent and all.
